resources.string: Turns the exterior screen into a soft light. Brightness is a request to the system, not measured light. Lock exposure and white balance before a take so the light does not make them drift.
Use the exterior screen as a fill light
Fill light is on. Lock exposure (AE) and white balance (AWB) before the take: if this light changes, they drift. The app never locks them for you.
Fill light is on and exposure is locked. Lock white balance (AWB) too, so a change in this light does not shift colour. The app never locks it for you.
Fill light timed out and is dimmed. The operator can turn it back on.
Phone is warm: the light is dimmed to protect the recording.
Phone is hot: the light is strongly dimmed to protect the recording.
Approximate colour; the cover panel is not calibrated.
Requested brightness: %1$d%% (a request, not measured light)
When the phone warms up (moderate thermal status or above) the light dims on its own and both screens say so. Capture is never changed.
